title: Claude Code Baseline Config
description: Drives which baseline hooks run and whether they block. Consumed by hooks/lib/common.sh.

minClaudeCodeVersion.description: Minimum Claude Code version (canonical semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, no leading zeros) the baseline's behavior was verified against. install.sh detects the live 'claude --version' and prints an advisory warning (never blocks) when it is older. Bump only alongside a RELEASING.md re-verification.

baselineVersion.description: Revision stamp for this baseline template (distinct from the schema 'version' integer). Written verbatim on a fresh install (create path only) and mirrored in hooks/VERSION; tools/baseline-status.sh --drift uses it to detect repos on an old baseline. Bump alongside hooks/VERSION every release.

enforcement.description: Global posture. 'block': hooks fail the tool call on violation. 'warn': hooks advise but never fail.

failClosed.description: When a security control cannot RUN (missing/malformed rules file, or Python unavailable), fail closed: under 'block' posture the hook exits 2 with a loud message instead of silently passing. Default true. Set false to downgrade such degradations to warnings.

guardrails.description: Always-on safety hooks. Disable only with deliberate intent.

extraPatterns.description: Additional case-insensitive substrings that block a Bash command.

modules.description: Opt-in hooks. Off by default; enable per repo.

rulesFile.description: Path (repo-relative or absolute) to the declarative rules file.

requireWhenEnv.description: If non-empty, only enforce when this environment variable is set.

configGuard.description: ConfigChange tamper-detection. When enabled, watches in-session changes to .claude/settings.json (project_settings) and blocks/warns if the baseline hook wiring or deny-list is stripped, or disableAllHooks is set.

commitGrep.description: Literal substring matched against recent commit subjects (fixed-string, not a regex).
